items.title: 75234_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: And this was Christy's he was talking about.

ctx.x: The Hi-Hat. I went up there and played, because Bird was supposed to go up and play, and he called me up at the last minute and said he didn't want to go. So he asked me would I go up if he got me the connection and had the guy call me. I said, 'Well, you have the guy call.' So he called me, and I decided... I went on up and I played there for the week. Then the last night, some cat come in and says, 'There's a guy who wants to meet you, wants you to come out to his place.' And this was Christy's he was talking…
That was like an after-hours place.
